name: explicit NPE mention vs no NPE mention
side_a: Credit (no deduction) when the answer explicitly mentions a NullPointerException or its possibility (e.g., “will throw a NullPointerException”, “potential NullPointerExceptions”).
side_b: Deduct when the answer never mentions a NullPointerException at all.

name: recommends null‑check vs says null‑check unnecessary
side_a: Answers that say a null check for mPrefix (and optionally mTopic) should be added before calling length() – these were credited.
side_b: Answers that claim a null check is unnecessary or that the existing condition already handles null – these were deducted.
